collision_check: Scanned studio/art/openkit-*/fbx: no hits for spoke/hub/tire/felloe. Near-misses avoided: prop-wheelbarrow(-wood), prop-potter-wheel-pt1, prop-spinning-wheel-tl1, cart-crate wheels, forge/smithy tools. prop-tire-iron-wr1 kept with brief's -wr1 suffix (tire-iron reads as generic smithy/auto tool).
judgment_calls: Spoke blanks are raw tapered square sticks (4-seg cones), no tenons/shaping, so they read as stock not a wheel part-kit
Hub blank is turned but unmortised, with a through bore; dark M_Iron disc at bore bottom is a visual cue only
Tire iron is a flat lever/tire-dog with hooked claw; lever, not a smithy hammer/tong remake; not a weapon
Felloe is a single 60-deg arc (1/6 of a 1.2 m rim), no spoke holes, no iron tire, standing on its ends
